title: Senior Creative Strategist – Paid Social / Online Video (m/f/d)
text:
A career driven by you. Join AutoScout24 Group and experience life in the fast lane. We’re not just leading the market; we’re creating it. We’re constantly innovating, evolving and transforming things for our customers. We’re driven, ambitious and determined to do our best work, together. For a career that doesn’t stand still, where you can put your ideas in the driving seat and change the way the world moves, join our global community. 
 As Senior Creative Strategist , you will shape how our brand shows up across paid social, YouTube, creator partnerships, and organic channels. 
 Your focus will be turning our brand strategy into clear, practical creative direction that works in-market. This means defining how the brand comes to life across ads, creators, and content formats in a way that is consistent, distinctive, and effective. 
 You will work closely with creators, agencies, and internal teams to bring that direction to life through high-quality short-form video and social creative. In partnership with the paid social team, you will help define the creative testing roadmap, using campaign insights and performance learnings to understand what resonates and continuously improve creative effectiveness over time. 
 Paid social and online video are key channels for rapid learning and iteration. You will use those learnings to strengthen how we show up across channels and help evolve how the brand is expressed going forward. 
 What You’ll Do 
 
 Develop creative concepts and write scripts, hooks and copy for paid social and YouTube ads, drawing on audience needs, brand priorities and campaign learnings. Formats include creator-led videos, AI Videos, product demos, motion graphics, and static ads. 
 Work closely with our AI Video Creator to develop feasible concepts, provide clear scripts and briefs, and give actionable creative feedback throughout AI video production. 
 Own the creative testing roadmap: define hypotheses, test, learn, and iterate on creative concepts, hooks, creator types etc. 
 Partner with the paid social performance marketing team to learn how ads are performing and determine what to test next. 
 Use insights and performance data to improve creative output and messaging 
 Review creator-submitted outlines, rough cuts, and final edits to ensure the work stays on brief before it goes live. 
 Define how AutoScout24 app/site moments show up inside creator content so the work is useful and credible, not just branded entertainment. 
 Collaborate with the Social Organic & Creator team to ensure brand consistency and share creative learnings across paid and organic social. 
 Explore AI tools and workflows to improve creative speed and efficiency 
 
 What You’ll Bring 
 
 8+ years of experience in brand, social creative, content strategy, or similar roles 
 Strong experience with short-form content production 
 Solid understanding of platforms like Meta, YouTube, and TikTok 
 Proven ability to turn brand ideas into effective ads and social content 
 Data-informed mindset with strong creative judgment (no heavy analytics required) 
 Experience briefing creators and creative production 
 Comfortable making clear go/no-go creative decisions 
 Hands-on experience using AI tools for creative production or iteration. Experience in collaboration with an AI Video Content Creator or similar production role is a plus. 
 Fluent English and German skills at minimum C1 level 
 Experience scaling creator-led or UGC content strategies; experience working in international or multi-market environments is a plus 
 
 
 What This Role Is Not 
 A community or social media management role 
 A pure performance marketing or media buying role 
 A traditional brand campaign role focused only on large launches 
 An agency coordination role without creative ownership

Here, you’ll have the tools, training and support you need to work in a way that suits you, learn new skills and reach your potential.

title: Engineering Manager - Data Platform (m/f/d)
text:
At AutoScout24 , our Data Platform Engineering team builds and operates the AWS-based platform that enables teams across the company to work with data independently. Built around Data Mesh principles, it provides the infrastructure, self-service tooling, and governance that allow domain teams to own and manage their data products. 
 As Engineering Manager , you'll lead the team responsible for developing and operating this platform. The role combines people leadership with strong technical involvement, from architecture and complex engineering problems to reliability, performance, and cost optimization. We're also making AI a native part of how our Data Engineering organization works and how people use our platform. This includes bringing AI directly into the daily workflows of Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers, as well as making the platform more intelligent, easier to use, and more accessible to business users. 
 What you'll do 
 
 Build a team that takes ownership, makes sound technical decisions, and delivers independently. 
 Evolve our AWS-based data platform, making decisions around architecture, reliability, performance, security, and cost. 
 Work alongside engineers on complex technical problems, including hands-on implementation when needed. 
 Develop and improve self-service capabilities for data pipelines, dataset discovery, access management, and data quality monitoring. 
 Strengthen our Data Mesh implementation, including domain ownership, data contracts, access controls, and federated governance. 
 Improve data quality, lineage, and observability through automation and platform-level controls. 
 Work closely with Product, Analytics Engineering, Data Governance, and business stakeholders to understand problems and develop solutions. 
 Integrate AI into existing engineering tools and workflows across Data Engineering and Analytics Engineering, improving how teams develop pipelines, build data models, test changes, review code, and troubleshoot failures. 
 Build AI capabilities directly into the data platform, helping users discover and understand datasets, work with data using natural language, investigate issues, and complete tasks that previously required technical knowledge or manual steps. 
 
 What we're looking for 
 
 5+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager , with a strong track record of hiring, coaching, and developing engineering teams. 
 Strong software or data engineering background, with recent hands-on technical experience and the ability to contribute to complex engineering decisions. 
 Extensive hands-on experience with AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar. You use these tools extensively in your own engineering work and understand how to use them effectively beyond basic code generation. 
 Proven experience integrating AI into engineering workflows across the SDLC , ideally for Data Engineering or Analytics Engineering teams. You've implemented solutions that engineers actually use in their daily work and can explain how they improved efficiency. 
 Experience building AI functionality into internal platforms or products , rather than just developing standalone chatbots. You understand how to integrate AI with existing tools, data, metadata, permissions, and workflows to make complex tasks easier for users. 
 A product mindset, with the ability to understand business and user needs, challenge proposed solutions, and work effectively with Product and other stakeholders. 
 Deep AWS expertise, particularly in designing, building, and operating production data platforms using services such as S3, Glue, Athena, IAM, MWAA and Lake Formation. 
 Strong understanding of data lake and lakehouse architectures, including storage, processing, metadata, security, performance, and cost. 
 Experience operating large-scale data platforms, troubleshooting production issues, and improving reliability and efficiency. 
 Proficiency in Python and SQL, along with practical experience in infrastructure as code, CI/CD, testing, and software engineering best practices. 
 Practical experience with Data Mesh principles, decentralized data ownership, self-service data infrastructure, and federated governance. 
 Experience implementing data quality, data contracts, observability, and access controls within production data platforms. 
 Strong communication and people leadership skills, with the ability to develop engineers, delegate responsibility, and build an effective, independent team.

title: Data Engineer

Fluency with AI-assisted workflows, leveraging modern tools to improve productivity and quality while critically evaluating their outputs and limitations. Curiosity, humility, and a collaborative mindset, with a commitment to continuous learning, sharing knowledge, and improving together. title: Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d)
text: What is Anori Tech doing? The world talks about batteries, cells and the energy transition. Almost nobody talks about the Battery Management System (BMS) that makes them work. As battery applications multiply, from robotics and mobility to data centers and grid-scale storage, BMS complexity is exploding. Legacy BMS architectures were never built for this: too rigid to keep up with new requirements, they've turned the BMS into the bottleneck of battery development. We're building something different: a novel software-defined BMS architecture combined with an AI-driven configuration process. It gets battery manufacturers the right BMS for their exact use case within days, regardless of application or cell chemistry. We're building the battery management system platform of tomorrow. Delivered in days, not years. Join us and shape one of the fastest growing markets in the energy sector: The BMS market. Our Motivation At Anori Tech, we believe everything is energy, and progress runs on it. With Anori we actively shape the energy transition: from oil to electric, from low to high efficiency. Our objective: put Europe back on the map in the race for the energy transition and build technical leadership out of Hamburg. About the Role A BMS is only as good as what it knows about the battery. As our Algorithm Engineer, you'll develop the algorithms that tell the Anori BMS what is happening inside the cells: state of charge, state of health and balancing. And you won't stop at the concept: you'll design algorithms, implement them in our embedded Rust firmware and validate them on real hardware. You'll work closely with Stefan, our CTO, and our firmware and hardware engineers. Start date : from January 1, 2027 What You'll Do Develop the algorithms that estimate SoC and SoH for different cell chemistries and applications Design balancing strategies that fit the hardware and use case Build battery models (e.g. equivalent circuit models) and parameterize them from measurement data with statistical rigor Implement your algorithms directly in the embedded Rust firmware, efficient enough for constrained hardware Design experiments and evaluation methodologies: analyze failure modes, quantify trade-offs between accuracy, robustness and compute cost Support in building data pipelines and fleet analytics in the cloud What You Bring Must have Hands-on experience with state of charge and state of health estimation, shown in a product, publication or substantial project. For example Kalman-type filters, H∞ filters, observers, or coulomb counting with model-based correction Deep understanding of battery behavior and modeling, e.g. equivalent circuit models, hysterisis, ageing or also physics based models Experience implementing numerical algorithms on embedded, constrained hardware (e.g. in Rust or C/C++ - heads-up our firmware is written in Rust, and we'll help you get up to speed) Strong Python skills for modeling, simulation and data analysis Critical, analytical, systematic thinking: you reason from first principles, make your assumptions explicit and challenge existing paradigms Strongly preferred Experience with cell balancing algorithms and their effects Working with real cell data from test benches or cyclers Signal processing fundamentals: FIR/IIR filter design, sampling and aliasing, noise characterization of sensor data Nice to have Data pipelines, fleet analytics or cloud experience Machine learning methods for battery data, for example data-driven state of health estimation or anomaly detection Model-based systems engineering and requirements engineering (the skills, not the paper) You don't tick every box? title: Business Development / Mba Co-Founder (F/M/D) Role At Startup Chillquanta
text:
CHILLQUANTA Bochum, Germany (Ruhr University Bochum) | On-site / Hybrid | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / Quantum & Semiconductor Metrology 
 About ChillQuanta ChillQuanta is developing an electro-optic spectrometer for inspecting and characterizing photonic qubits (semiconductor quantum-dot single- and entangled-photon sources), aiming to replace or combine today's separate methods (capacitance-voltage, photoluminescence, resonance fluorescence spectroscopy) with one new sub-100-femtosecond-resolution, non-destructive electro-optic technique — with a patent filing already in progress. Target market: quantum and semiconductor chip makers. 
 The opportunity Founded by Amar Alok (CEO, PhD in Experimental Physics from RUB, 4+ years in ultrafast optics and pump-probe spectroscopy) alongside a Chemistry postdoc, ChillQuanta has a lab prototype (TRL 3-4) benchmarked against single-atom data, an Invention Disclosure accepted by RUB (April 2026) with a manuscript in preparation for Physical Review Letters, and over €12k raised so far. The next step is turning the lab prototype into an automated instrument and deciding between licensing and starting a company — which is where a business co-founder comes in. ChillQuanta is separately also open to an AI/ML co-founder to help build wafer-scale AI prediction capability. 
 Tasks 
 What you will own 
 Company build-up & strategy - Help decide and execute the path from lab prototype to company: licensing vs. start-up, incorporation, and go-to-market strategy for the quantum/semiconductor metrology market. - Own fundraising strategy and investor relations as ChillQuanta moves beyond its initial ~€12k raised. 
 Commercialization - Turn the lab prototype (TRL 3-4) into an automated, sellable instrument in partnership with the technical team. - Build relationships with semiconductor and quantum chip makers as early customers and design partners. Business operations - Establish the commercial and operational foundation (pricing, business model, partnerships) the founding science team doesn't yet have. 
 Requirements 
 What you bring 
 Core experience - Business development or MBA-level commercial experience, ideally with deep-tech, scientific instrumentation, or semiconductor/quantum industry exposure. - Comfort making a licensing-vs-startup call and building a go-to-market plan from a lab-stage prototype. 
 Especially valuable - Existing network in quantum technology, semiconductor metrology, or scientific instrumentation. - Fundraising experience for deep-tech ventures (grants and/or investors). - ChillQuanta is separately seeking an AI/ML co-founder to build wafer-scale AI prediction — relevant ML/software experience is valuable for that parallel track. 
 Benefits 
 Why join ChillQuanta - A validated lab prototype (TRL 3-4) benchmarked against single-atom data, with an Invention Disclosure already accepted by RUB and a manuscript heading to Physical Review Letters. - A genuinely novel technique (patent filing in progress) addressing a real gap in photonic-qubit inspection for the fast-growing quantum and semiconductor chip markets. - Ground-floor business co-founder equity alongside a strong physics/chemistry founding team. 
 ChillQuanta welcomes co-founder candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, sexual identity, or any other characteristic. title: Founding Principal Engineer (m/f/d)
text: About us Most labs still count cells under a microscope by hand. It's slow, repetitive, and error-prone. We're replacing that manual work with software. By combining a standard microscope with a smartphone, we run computer vision models that locate, track, and measure cells automatically in real time. We're starting with semen analysis and expanding to other routine microscopic samples. We're a small, well-funded team in Berlin, founded in 2026. Our goal is to make automated, reliable diagnostic analysis accessible on any phone connected to a microscope. The role We're looking for an engineer who wants to own the whole platform behind a medical product: services, data, infrastructure, security and identity. A first version runs today. The hard part is making it trustworthy enough for clinical use: patient data that stays safe, an audit trail that holds up for years, and a system that recovers when something breaks. You'll own all of it, working closely with the founders and our CTO. What you'll do Own the platform end to end: backend, data, infrastructure and security. Get it ready for clinical use, and keep it reliable as we grow. Build identity, access and data handling that clinics and auditors can trust. Make the architecture calls: what to build now, what to defer, what to cut. Set the engineering standard and help hire the team that follows. What you bring Platforms you've built and run. You've built backend platforms from scratch and run them in production, through outages, data incidents, migrations and growth. Database depth. You know what happens under the query: indexing, locking, transactions, replication, zero-downtime schema changes, and backups you've actually restored. Security by default. Authentication and authorisation, tenant isolation, secrets, audit logging. You think about how a system gets attacked before it ships. Identity done properly. Identity providers, sessions and tokens, roles and permissions, onboarding and offboarding. Infrastructure. Infrastructure as code, containers, Linux, networking and cloud are everyday tools for you. Beyond the backend. The backend is your home, but when the product needs it, you read and change the app yourself. Systematic troubleshooting. You reproduce first and fix root causes. You work from evidence like logs, traces, metrics and query plans, and you stay calm when production breaks. AI-native engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily work. You give them good context, split work into reviewable steps, and stand behind every line you ship. Ownership. You help shape the roadmap, push back on weak ideas, set your own priorities and raise problems early. Nobody has to chase you. Strong opinions, held with evidence and open to revision. Range. You've worked across several companies, stacks or environments. How you work counts far more than how many years you've done it. Nice to have Regulated environments with audits: medical devices, health, finance. Serving ML models in production. What we offer Ownership from day one. As a founding engineer, you're part of the company through our virtual share option plan (VSOP). You grow with us. As the company grows, your role grows with it. Real influence. You decide how we build software, and you shape the engineering team we build. A competitive salary. A product that matters: a medical device for real clinics, built together with clinicians and lab staff. Flexible hours and office days. We work from Berlin and meet in person regularly, up to several days a week. This isn't a fully remote role. English is our working language. German isn't required. title: Senior AI Software Engineer
text:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. The team 
 NiCE Labs (nice.com/nice-labs) is where NiCE explores what's next in AI for customer experience. This role is on AI Innovation, the Labs pillar that builds and validates new AI capabilities through prototypes, so the company can make better product decisions, faster. 
 We're a deliberately small, senior team of builders inside NiCE Cognigy, the AI agent platform. We operate in fast iteration cycles: spot an emerging capability, build a working prototype, validate it against real metrics (quality, latency, cost, user impact), and then decide: kill it, iterate, publish it, or hand it off to a product team. Some of our work is public, like the open-sourced Cognigy Platform MCP server; most of it shapes the product roadmap from the inside. 
 We hire for product mindset and builder mentality. Everyone on the team takes ideas from zero to working software, shows them to real users, and argues from evidence. 
 So, what’s the role all about? 
 You'll work at the intersection of frontier AI capabilities and a real enterprise product. The field moves faster than any roadmap can track. Your job is to close that gap: turn new models, protocols, and agent patterns into working systems, prove what matters in realistic scenarios, and produce the insights and reference implementations that let product and engineering teams move with confidence. 
 You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity, at home where best practices don't exist yet, and quick to move on when the results point elsewhere. 
 How will you make an impact? 
 
 Build agentic systems and full-stack prototypes end-to-end, shipping a first version in days and learning from real use 
 Track the frontier (new models, agent patterns, protocols like MCP) and turn the promising ones into working prototypes rather than slideware 
 Design experiments that show whether a concept holds up, measured in quality, latency, cost, and user impact 
 Work directly with internal users, product managers, and customers to validate concepts early and iterate quickly 
 Turn validated prototypes into reference implementations and write-ups that product teams can build on, then hand off cleanly and move to the next bet 
 Give product and platform teams concrete feedback on where AI capabilities shine and where they fall short 
 Move between initiatives as priorities shift. What you learn on one bet compounds into the next 
 
 Have you got what it takes? 
 
 Have 4+ years building full-stack software, including things you started from nothing. We weigh what you've shipped more than years on a CV 
 Have shipped LLM-powered systems to production:features real users depended on, not demos or notebooks 
 Understand AI agents below the framework level: message arrays, tool calling, context management, prompt caching. You could build an agent loop from scratch and explain why it works 
 Use AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) as your default way of working, and it makes you measurably faster, not just busier 
 Are full-stackin practice: comfortable taking a prototype from API to demo UI on your own (our stack centers on TypeScript/Node.js and React) 
 Do your best work when the ground is still moving. New territory energises you more than a settled plan 
 Think in user problems first, solutions second 
 
 You will have an advantage if you also have: 
 
 A strong eye for UX/UI: you can make a prototype feel like a product, and you notice when one lacks that eye 
 Experience with voice and real-time AI: streaming, speech-to-text/text-to-speech, voice-to-voice models 
 Open-source work on agent tooling (MCP servers, harnesses, evals) 
 Experience designing evaluations for AI systems 
 Background in conversational AI or customer-experience products 
 
 Enjoy NICE-FLEX! 
 At NICE, we work according to the NICE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

title: Senior Paid Social Manager
text:
A BOUT TIDE 
 At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

 Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. 
 Tide facts: 
 
 Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs 
 Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing 
 Over $300 million raised in funding 
 3,000 Tideans globally 
 Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026 
 We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg 
 About You 
 We’re looking for a Senior Paid Social Manager who can strategically lead and scale our acquisition efforts across paid social channels in the UK and Europe. You’ll bring deep expertise in managing multi-million-pound budgets, a data-driven approach, and a proven track record of driving large-scale growth. You will be responsible for leading strategy, execution, and innovation in our paid social performance, ensuring we stay ahead of platform changes and industry trends. You’ll also have a clear view on how AI is changing performance marketing, and you’ll build a team that uses it well. 
 You’ll be a Meta expert, with hands-on experience across bidding strategies, audience segmentation, attribution, and creative testing. Additionally, you’ll have experience scaling campaigns across TikTok, Twitter, LinkedIn. You’ll be a martech-savvy professional, comfortable with tracking solutions, first-party data activation, working with MMPs and advanced attribution modeling. 
 You will play a key role in shaping Tide’s international expansion and long-term paid social strategy, ensuring that performance marketing continues to be a key growth driver. This is an opportunity to lead and grow Tide’s in-house Paid Social team as an AI-enabled team, making a significant impact on the business. 
 Some of the things you’ll be doing: 
 
 Owning and scaling paid social performance globally , ensuring we maximise efficiency and return on investment across all platforms. 
 Managing and optimising multi-million-pound budgets , using advanced bidding strategies and automation tools to drive sustained growth. 
 Building an AI-enabled paid social team , deciding which work AI should handle (creative production, reporting, bid and budget management) and which stays with people, then training the team to work that way. 
 Embedding AI into creative and testing workflows , using generative tools to develop concepts, copy and variants faster, with clear quality, brand and compliance checks. 
 Using AI and automation across the account , from platform tools such as Advantage+ to custom scripts, agents and reporting workflows that cut manual work. 
 Developing and executing the paid social roadmap , identifying new opportunities, testing innovative strategies, and expanding our presence across emerging platforms. 
 Driving a full-funnel approach , from awareness campaigns to high-intent lead generation and conversion, leveraging creative and audience insights. 
 Collaborating with cross-functional teams (Data, Product, Web, Creative, and more) to align paid social strategies with Tide’s wider growth objectives. 
 Championing attribution and measurement , ensuring best-in-class tracking, incrementality testing, and first-party data activation. 
 Leading creative strategy , working closely with designers and copywriters to continuously test and optimise assets for performance. 
 Staying ahead of industry changes , including privacy regulations (SKAD, ATT, IFDA), AI-driven platform updates , and new advertising solutions. 
 Building and mentoring a high-performing, AI-literate paid social team , shaping the function as we scale both in the UK and internationally. 
 
 You’ll be a great fit if: 
 
 You have 7+ years of experience in paid social marketing, managing large-scale campaigns across multiple platforms. 
 You have a proven track record of driving large volumes of B2B acquisition through paid social. 
 You’re an expert in Meta advertising (Facebook & Instagram), with deep knowledge of bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and ad creative best practices. 
 You have extensive hands-on experience with LinkedIn Ads, Twitter, TikTok, and other secondary paid social platforms. 
 You’re highly analytical, comfortable with incrementality testing, MMM, and data-driven decision-making. 
 You have strong technical knowledge of tracking solutions, attribution modeling, and martech tools (Appsflyer, GA4, GTM, CDPs, Looker/Tableau, etc.). 
 You have hands-on experience using AI in marketing, such as generative tools for creative and copy, LLMs for analysis, and automation for reporting and optimisation. 
 You have experience building or leading a team that uses AI day to day, including setting standards, sharing prompts and workflows, and measuring the productivity gain. 
 You’re comfortable with Meta’s AI-led campaign products (Advantage+, automated bidding) and know when to trust automation and when to override it. 
 You have sound judgement on AI risk, including brand safety, accuracy of claims and data privacy, ideally in a regulated industry such as financial services. 
 You understand how to drive performance across web traffic, mobile apps, and lead generation channels. 
 You have a test-and-learn mindset, with a structured approach to experimentation and optimisation. 
 You can effectively communicate complex insights, using data visualisation tools to tell compelling performance stories. 
 You have experience managing agency relationships, but also thrive in an in-house, hands-on environment. 
 You’re a natural leader, with experience mentoring and growing a team of paid social professionals. 
 Fluency in a second language (French or German) is preferable. 
 
 What you’ll get in return: 
 
 Make work, work for you! We embrace flexible working and remote-first arrangements. 
 25 days holiday + bank holidays. 
 Vitality Health and Dental Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical well-being. 
 £1,000 L&D budget per year, plus up to three L&D paid days off. 
 Enhanced family-friendly leave. 
 Work abroad for up to 90 days a year. 
 Snacks, drinks, and social events in our offices. 
 
 Tidean Ways of Working 
 At Tide, we’re Member First and Data Driven, but above all, we’re One Team. We trust our employees to work in a way that suits them while delivering great results. Our offices are always available for those who want to collaborate in person, and we support remote work across the UK. 
 TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE 
 At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 
 We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard. 
 
 At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

 Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.

title: Software Engineer - Research Participants - United Kingdom
text:
Software Engineer - Research Participants - United Kingdom 
 
 
 Location: Remote (UK) Type of contract: Freelance Hourly Rate: £19 (pay based on actual study time) 
 About Prolific 
 Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world. 
 Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills. 
 The Role Do you have a device with a microphone? Get paid to take part in voice interviews. We’re inviting software engineers and developers based in the UK to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change. This is a paid research participation opportunity, not a job as a software engineer. Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts. 
 Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal. 
 The project launches in about one week, and places are allocated on a first come, first served basis, so please sign up as soon as you can. 
 What you’ll be doing 
 
 Taking part in a short voice conversation with another participant 
 Completing a short online survey sharing your views and experiences 
 Giving honest, considered responses based on your own perspective 
 Watching the community research goal progress as more participants take part 
 
 What you’ll bring 
 
 Residence in the UK 
 Fluent English 
 A device with a working microphone 
 No research experience or specialist research qualifications required. We want a genuine cross-section of the UK population. 
 
 Why join this project? This is a chance to be part of something meaningful and have a say in research aimed at shaping policy. Once the findings are published, we’ll share them with participants so you can see the impact of your contribution. 
 Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again. Simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for this and future opportunities. 
 Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant 
 Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using your professional expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home. 
 We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. 
 We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
text:
Our Global Structure 
 Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person. 
 We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform. 
 This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch. 
 We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one. 
 This role will be based in London , UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin. 
 What you'll do: 
 
 Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers. 
 Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout. 
 Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times. 
 Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer. 
 Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter. 
 Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team. 
 Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event. 
 
 Our expectations: 
 
 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production. 
 1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly. 
 A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one. 
 Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar). 
 Willingness to operate what you build, including a share of on-call, with a pragmatic approach to reliability. 
 Uses AI tooling in day-to-day development and can critically evaluate its output for correctness and quality. 
 
 Nice to have 
 
 Experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or financial crime, especially money movement fraud, bank account linking fraud, payout abuse, or lending fraud. 
 Experience with rules engines, real-time feature stores, or ML model serving in a decisioning path. 
 Background in Kotlin, Java, Python, or Node.js alongside Go. 
 Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP). 
 Experience working across multiple brands, regions, or regulatory regimes. 
 
 What we value 
 
 A product-oriented mindset. You think beyond the ticket, understand the "why" behind the work, and take a high level of responsibility for outcomes rather than output. 
 Comfort with ambiguity. This is a new team on a new surface; parts of the charter are still being drawn, and you will help draw them. 
 A track record of owning a project or feature end to end, especially in fast-paced environments.

title: Senior Electrical Product Engineer - Maritime Engineering
text:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. About the Role 
 The Senior Product Engineer is the primary electrical design engineering presence on the production floor, bridging the gap between design intent and production execution. The role sits within Platform Engineering and is based primarily at the production site, dispositioning nonconformances and Material Review Board (MRB) actions for electrical systems and sub-assemblies, resolving design questions in real time, and closing the loop between production and design so that issues get root caused and fixed at the source. To hold that authority credibly, this role also contributes to upstream electrical design - architecture, analysis, schematics, and design reviews - so they have the depth needed to make sound disposition decisions on the floor. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong technical judgement in electrical and power systems engineering, the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced production environment, and the credibility to influence both design engineers and production teams. You will be expected to drive systemic improvements, cutting repeat nonconformances through changes to the design and documentation, as well as resolving individual issues. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Production Floor Engineering Support 
 
 Serve as the primary electrical design engineering point of contact on the production floor for assigned programs and product lines 
 Represent the design authority at Material Review Board (MRB) for electrical systems, working with Quality and Manufacturing to minimise production hold time without compromising product safety and integrity 
 Resolve production process-blockers, design ambiguities, and schematic/drawing interpretation issues in real time, exercising engineering judgement within defined authority boundaries 
 Provide rapid-response engineering support and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to Production, Quality, and Test teams for electrical nonconformance resolution, use-as-is/rework/scrap decisions, and repair dispositions 
 Identify and escalate systemic electrical design issues to core Design Engineering teams with clear problem statements, data, and recommended corrective actions 
 Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations, and analysis to support MRB dispositions, deviation requests, and use-as-is justifications (e.g. power budgets, thermal derating, circuit analysis, connector/harness assessments) 
 
 Electrical Design Contribution 
 
 Contribute to the design, development and integration of electrical systems and subsystems, maintaining the technical depth needed to hold disposition authority on the production floor 
 Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations and analysis (circuit analysis, power budgets, thermal derating, EMC/EMI) to support both design decisions and MRB dispositions 
 Participate in design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR) and contribute to system-level trade studies 
 Collaborate cross-functionally with mechanical, software, and systems engineering to integrate electrical systems into the vehicle 
 
 Design Intent Translation & Multi-Site Support 
 
 Support the translation of electrical design intent into production-executable work across multiple product versions, configurations, and manufacturing sites 
 Support the stand-up and ramp of production at new or expanding manufacturing sites, ensuring electrical design engineering knowledge transfers effectively 
 Raise and implement engineering changes to correct production issues that originate in the electrical design, through the Anduril configuration management and change process 
 Feed production observations, failure modes and DFM/DFA opportunities back into Platform Electrical design work through structured feedback, prioritised using data 
 
 Design to Production Interface 
 
 Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering on work instruction (WI) development, tooling validation, and First Article Inspection (FAI) activities for electrical assemblies, communicating the design intent and acceptance criteria 
 Own the resolution of EBOM discrepancies found in production for electrical assemblies, and give engineering input to Configuration Management and Manufacturing Engineering on PLM workflows, BOM reconciliation and work instruction tooling 
 Identify patterns across electrical nonconformances, test failures and build issues, and lead engineering root cause analysis and design corrective action implementation 
 Collaborate on the improvement of key tool and functional interfaces (PLM workflows, digital work instructions, BOM reconciliation) that impact design-to-production efficiency 
 Support the development of scalable frameworks for multi-site production: configuration management alignment, site-specific work instruction adaptation, and cross-site lesson-learned sharing 
 Build repeatable playbooks for standing up production of new product variants, reducing ramp time and first-unit defects at each additional site 
 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration & Metrics 
 
 Maintain strong working relationships with Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, and Program Management to ensure aligned priorities and rapid issue resolution 
 Collate and drive corrective actions on design-originated production issues, providing data-backed prioritisation to core Design Engineering teams 
 Participate in Production readiness reviews, design reviews (P&DFMEA, DFM/A/T) and engineering change assessments 
 
 Key Competencies & Attributes 
 
 Engineering Judgement: Technical depth in electrical and power systems combined with production pragmatism - able to make sound engineering decisions under time pressure without over-engineering solutions 
 Design Authority Integrity: You protect product safety and integrity under schedule pressure, understand the limits of your delegated authority and escalate when you should 
 Cross-Functional Influence: Credibility with both design engineers and production operators; able to speak both languages and bridge communication gaps 
 Autonomy & Initiative: Comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities in a fast-moving production environment; able to self-direct and prioritise without constant direction 
 Systems Thinking: Thinks beyond individual issue resolution to identify patterns, root causes, and scalable solutions that prevent recurrence across sites and variants 
 Communication: Clear, concise technical communication - written dispositions, engineering reports, and presentations to leadership 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field 
 Proven experience in a senior role within defence, tech or any fast-paced environment, driving successful electrical engineering projects from concept to market launch 
 Expertise in electrical engineering principles, techniques, and technologies, with a track record of delivering innovative solutions 
 Proficiency in using industry-standard electrical design and simulation software 
 Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and mentor junior engineers while fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation 
 Strong time management and organisational abilities, with a demonstrated ability to deliver projects on time and within budget 
 Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to think creatively and adapt to diverse and evolving challenges 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 
 Familiarity with fast paced environment best practices, including agility, adaptability, and the ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment 
 Ability to obtain and maintain a NV2 Australian Government Security Clearance 
 Demonstrated hands-on experience working on or directly supporting a production floor 
 Understanding of Material Review Board (MRB) processes, nonconformance management, and engineering disposition (use-as-is, rework, scrap, return to vendor) 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
 Experience designing electrical and power systems for unmanned vehicles 
 Experience in the subsea or maritime domain 
 Experience working on defence programs and familiarity with current Defence standards 
 Previous experience as a Product, Sustaining, Liaison or Production Support Engineer with delegated design or disposition authority 
 Experience with first article inspection (e.g. AS9102) and production test development 
 Familiarity with IPC/WHMA-A-620 and/or IPC-A-610

text:

Job Overview: We are seeking a Manufacturing Test Engineer to join Anduril, working in a cutting-edge start-up environment to advance the state-of-the-possible in subsea robotics. The Manufacturing Test Engineer will be charged with developing and implementing high-fidelity, automated test processes on both the component and system level. Working closely with engineering staff and a team of skilled electro-mechanical technicians, this role is key to advancing our testing capabilities to ensure the highest levels quality are achieved as we continue drive scalability into our production operations. About the Team Anduril’s Manufacturing team is producing the next generation of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles globally at rate. The Manufacturing Engineering team owns production readiness and process engineering across the Undersea Dominance product range — from core vehicle platform to specialised mission payloads, spanning mechanical and electrical hardware build through to full system integration & test. About the Job You will own the test software, automation and tooling that proves every Dive-XL vehicle works before it leaves the building — the Python frameworks that drive instruments and vehicle hardware, the operator-facing GUIs that make complex test sequences safe and repeatable under production pressure, and the interlocks that protect people and product when the system is commanding real high-voltage DC. You will also own the infrastructure underneath: NixOS-based station builds, test result flow into MES, and the configuration management that keeps a fleet of test stations reproducible and rollback-safe. If you thrive hands-on — oscilloscopes and protocol analysers as often as a code editor — in a fast-paced environment where the architecture is yours to build, this role is for you. What You'll Do 
 
 Build a broad range of test capabilities across the manufacturing value stream - PCBA bring up, electrical boxes/bottles bring-up, system level checkouts and acceptance testing to key component level in process validation. 
 Develop, execute, and manage test eco-system to de-risk hardware and ensure product meets target reliability levels and ultimate design intent.

 Design, implement and maintain semi-automated testing equipment/protocols for subsystem characterization and testing.

 Collaborate with the design/systems team throughout product development cycles to perform risk assessments, maintain ownership of test deployment activities in production, oversee technician training, burn down bug fixes/improvements as needed.

 REQUIRED QUALIFIACTIONS

 Experience with computer hardware communication protocols: USB, Ethernet, RS232, RS485, PCIe, HDMI, CAN, etc 
 3+ years of experience in a relevant field, preferably test design of electro-mechanical hardware in a manufacturing environment 
 Are well versed with complex electromechanical systems and are passionate about understanding what it takes to make them work reliably 
 Have experience developing full system test plans and know how to execute them on fast-paced product development timelines 
 Have experience with programming/testing a wide range of sensors, actuators, and electrical components 
 Can prototype and run your own tests, from experimental setup to hardware and software implementation 
 Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government NV2 Security Clearance (Australian citizen). 
 
 PREFERRED QUALIFIACTIONS 
 
 Experience in sub-sea robotics or AUV/UUV industries 
 Familiar with Product Life Cycle (PLM) systems, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and Test Execution Systems (TES) 
 Demonstrated ability to learn new skills or adapt to new situations. Un-phased by challenges that go beyond the traditional comfort zone or work experience. Multidisciplinary approach to problem solving 
 Comfortable with high project ownership under technical and schedule pressure, particularly where the scope and definition are limited 
 Experience testing and operating with or around hazardous systems (high voltage up to 400V)

 Experience with NixOS, or anydeclarative-configuration background (Ansible, Puppet, Chef).

title: Senior Manager, AI Architect
text:
About Baringa 
 Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding. 
 The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation. 
 Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors. 
 Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms. 
 Our Solutions & AI Lab (SAIL) practice are looking for an experienced AI Architect to join the team. 
 Our Solutions & AI Labs practice helps clients control their data, turn it into actionable insight, and better leverage it through AI and Machine Learning solutions embedded directly into business processes. We support clients across a range of industries and offer deep expertise in AI/ML, Cloud, Platform Engineering and Managed Solutions. 
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager to serve as an AI Architect — someone who can design the end-to-end architecture for enterprise AI platforms, lead consultancy engagements, and grow our AI & Solutions Engineering capability. 
 The AI Architect role owns the technical blueprint for AI-enabled solutions delivered in and around our clients’ environments, combining deep architectural specialism with the commercial and leadership skills to shape and grow our practice. This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of client advisory, AI platform architecture and hands-on delivery leadership — and who has a genuine passion for bringing AI systems to production at scale. 
 What you will be doing 
 As a Senior Manager and AI Architect, you will own and lead the architecture of complex AI programmes end-to-end — from shaping the opportunity and winning the work, through solution design, delivery governance and team leadership. You will bring SME-level depth in enterprise AI architecture and apply it to create real, lasting value for our clients. 
 Although we do not expect you to be an expert in every technology listed below simultaneously, our team consists of people who can advise clients as well as bring deep technical knowledge when needed. Key responsibilities span the following areas. 
 Engagement & delivery leadership 
 
 Own and lead the architecture of complex AI and data transformation engagements, taking accountability for solution design, quality, technical risk and client outcomes. 
 
 
 Lead and resource multi-disciplinary delivery teams — architects, engineers, data scientists and consultants — providing clear direction, technical oversight and people development. 
 
 
 Manage engagement resourcing: forecast team requirements, work with practice leadership to staff engagements, and develop the talent pipeline through mentoring of junior practitioners. 
 
 
 Proactively identify and manage delivery and architectural risks in complex stakeholder environments, escalating appropriately and maintaining client confidence throughout. 
 
 
 Communicate clearly to both technical teams and senior client stakeholders, translating architectural complexity into actionable insight and decisive recommendation. 
 
 
 Conduct rigorous architecture and design reviews and uphold engineering standards across every engagement you lead. 
 
 Stakeholder management & advisory 
 
 Act as a trusted advisor to client architects, CTOs, CDAOs and engineering leads, earning trust through depth of knowledge and a demonstrable delivery track record. 
 
 
 Build and maintain strong, senior client relationships, navigating competing priorities across business, technology and risk functions. 
 
 
 Facilitate architecture workshops and decision forums, driving alignment across diverse stakeholder groups and securing buy-in for target-state designs. 
 
 
 Translate business strategy into architectural roadmaps, sequencing investment and change in a way that balances ambition with deliverability. 
 
 Business development & bid support 
 
 Play a leading role in business development: identifying new opportunities, shaping propositions, and supporting or leading bids and tender responses for AI and technology engagements. 
 
 
 Contribute to proposal writing, articulating our capabilities and differentiators, including authoring technical and architecture sections of bid responses to client tenders and RFPs. 
 
 
 Support practice-level growth initiatives, including account planning, capability development, and go-to-market positioning for AI architecture and solutions engineering services. 
 
 Technical architecture — what you will design 
 You will be the design authority for enterprise AI platforms, able to reason across the full stack and make credible technology selections. We expect expert-level depth in several of the areas below and working knowledge across the rest. 
 AI platform & cloud architecture 
 
 Architect AI and Data Platforms using a mix of technologies including Databricks, Snowflake, Claude Enterprise and the native services of Azure, AWS and GCP - selecting the right tool for the workload rather than defaulting to a single vendor. 
 
 
 Design for scalability, security, cost efficiency and multi-cloud / hybrid patterns, with a strong grasp of containerisation, infrastructure-as-code, event-driven architectures and CI/CD. 
 
 
 Balance technical excellence with delivery pragmatism and commercial realities, championing the path from prototype to production. 
 
 Enterprise AI ecosystem integration 
 
 Bring awareness of the broader enterprise landscape and how AI integrates with core operational systems such as SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow and other systems of record and engagement. 
 
 
 Design integration patterns that let AI capabilities interoperate safely with enterprise data, identity, workflow and process automation platforms – including MCP and A2A and how these capabilities enable an enterprise Agent mesh. 
 
 
 Understand the data, governance and change implications of embedding AI into mission-critical enterprise processes. 
 
 Orchestration & control plane 
 
 Architect the orchestration and control-plane layer that governs how AI capabilities are exposed, routed and managed across the enterprise. 
 
 
 Design MCP, AI and LLM gateway layers for secure, observable and policy-controlled access to models and tools. 
 
 
 Design agent and skills registries — including recommending suitable technologies and patterns — to enable discovery, reuse and governance of agentic capabilities. 
 
 
 Define the control plane for routing, rate limiting, cost management, model selection and version control across multiple model providers. 
 
 AI solution design 
 
 Design retrieval and reasoning architectures including RAG, corrective RAG (CRAG), and agentic patterns, selecting the right approach for a given business problem. 
 
 
 Architect agent harnesses and their components — planning, memory, tool use, state management and multi-agent coordination. 
 
 
 Design prompt strategies, context management and grounding approaches for reliable, production-grade LLM behaviour. 
 
 Evaluation, guardrails & responsible AI 
 
 Design evaluation frameworks and guardrails that make AI systems safe, reliable and measurable — covering accuracy, safety, bias, and task success. 
 
 
 Embed responsible-AI and governance controls aligned to emerging regulation and client risk appetites. 
 
 
 Define human-in-the-loop and fallback strategies for high-stakes use cases. 
 
 Observability & operations 
 
 Architect logging, monitoring, tracing and cost-observability across the AI stack, including model, agent and platform telemetry. 
 
 
 Design for drift detection, performance monitoring and continuous evaluation in production (LLMOps / MLOps). 
 
 
 Establish operational patterns for reliability, incident response and lifecycle management of AI systems at scale. 
 
 Your skills and experience 
 We're seeking a technically credible, commercially aware leader who brings a rare combination of architectural depth, delivery accountability and client advisory skill — someone energised by the complexity of taking AI solutions to production at scale. 
 
 7+ years in technology consulting, architecture or AI/ML engineering, with at least 3 years in a senior leadership or lead-architect role — including accountability for end-to-end solution design, resourcing and commercial outcomes. 
 
 
 Proven ability to architect enterprise AI platforms across a mix of technologies (Databricks, Snowflake, Azure, AWS, GCP) with strong design capability across cloud, data and AI domains. 
 
 
 Working understanding of how AI integrates with major operational systems such as SAP, Salesforce and ServiceNow. 
 
 
 Hands-on knowledge of agentic AI, LLM gateways, MCP, RAG/CRAG, agent harnesses, evaluations and guardrails, and AI observability. 
 
 
 Demonstrable experience designing and leading data & AI transformation programmes, and building high-performing teams in complex stakeholder environments — engaging comfortably at CTO, CDAO or engineering-director level. 
 
 
 Track record of supporting or leading bid and proposal activity, including writing technical and architecture sections of responses to tenders and RFPs. 
 
 
 A clear, confident communicator able to make the complex accessible for technical and non-technical audiences alike. 
 
 
 Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science or a related discipline, or equivalent depth through relevant certifications (e.g. AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Google Professional ML Engineer, Databricks / Azure / GCP architecture credentials). 
 
 Industry experience 
 We would particularly like to hear from people who have designed and led data & AI transformation programmes across one or more of the following sectors: 
 
 Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) 
 
 
 Retail 
 
 
 Pharmaceuticals & Life Sciences 
 
 
 Manufacturing 
 
 
 Financial Services 
 
 
 Government and Public Services 
 
 Prior experience as an embedded or forward-deployed architect within a client environment, and exposure to regulated industries would be desired.

 Putting   People   First. 
 Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 
 
 Generous Annual Leave Policy:  We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service.

 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 
 An award-winning workplace

 Using business as a force for good.

We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.

text: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. Ex-founders welcome Experience inside a high-growth startup, or building your own, is highly desirable Curious about sales: you’re keen to learn how our BDRs and AEs work, and how Salesforce is set up, before you build for them AI-tool obsessed: you are constantly testing new models, agents, MCPs and workflows, and you have the judgement to turn them into reliable systems that people actually adopt Strong data instincts: you can turn fragmented, messy information into reliable workflows and create feedback loops that keep it trustworthy Can’t unsee inefficiency: you see the company as a connected system; when you find a broken or unnecessarily manual process, your instinct is to understand it, build the fix and make sure it sticks ⚠️ This role may not be for you if you: Prefer deep specialization over breadth: this role means switching between projects and teams, depending on business needs Prefer steady-state work over project-based sprints: priorities will shift as the business evolves Only want “strategic” work: you will personally build the tools, clean the data and fix the workflows ❌ This role is definitely not for you if you: Need every task to be clearly scoped before starting: ambiguity and learning on the fly are constant Avoid operational grunt work or lose interest after the prototype Want to protect a 9-to-6 or a mostly remote setup: we are in the office together 4–5 days a week and the pace is high What We Offer We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime.
