text: Product Engineer | Design Engineering Knowledge Location: Cambridge (UK), hybrid with up to 2 remote days per week Team: Product Start date: ASAP About Neural Concept Neural Concept is the engineering intelligence platform used by leading manufacturers in automotive, aerospace, and energy. We combine geometric and physics AI with LLM-based agents so engineering teams can move from customer requirements to validated designs in a fraction of the usual time. About the role Design decisions depend on information that lives outside the CAD model: customer requirements, design rules, manufacturing and assembly constraints, and cost targets. This information is spread across specification documents, handbooks, ERP systems, requirements management tools, and system models. Engineers gather it by hand, often late in the process, and conflicts surface at design reviews or on the production line. We call the capability that closes this gap Design Engineering Knowledge. It connects the design to the information ecosystem around it, so requirements, constraints, and trade-offs are available to engineers and AI agents while they work on the design itself. As a Product Engineer, you will build this capability. Requirements are the first focus area: extracting them from customer specifications and requirements management systems, structuring them, and keeping them traceable. You will then extend the same foundation to design rule checks, Design for Manufacturing (DfM), Design for Assembly (DfA), and Design for Cost, and connect it to the enterprise systems where this knowledge already lives. You will work with the Product Manager, solution engineers, and customer engineering teams, as the primary developer from the first customer conversation to the version running in production. What you will do Build the requirements foundation: ingest customer specifications and RFQ packages, extract requirements with LLM and agent-based pipelines, and keep each one traceable to its source document and page. Extend this foundation to design rules, DfM, DfA, and Design for Cost, turning standards, handbooks, and company know-how into constraints that software and agents can use. Bring requirements, constraints, and trade-offs into the design workflow, so engineers can check a design against them at any stage and see which ones apply to the part they are working on. Build integrations with the systems around the design: requirements management systems, ERP (cost, materials, and supplier data), and system design and MBSE tools for architecture and system-level requirements. Design the data model that links requirements, rules, and constraints to parts, design parameters, and simulation results. Create evaluation sets and quality metrics with customers, so extraction and checking accuracy is measured and improves with every release. Design human-in-the-loop review flows where engineers validate and edit AI output, with versioning and a full audit trail. Spot recurring patterns across customers and turn them into reusable components of the Neural Concept platform. Who you are Must have Experience building and shipping production Python software in fast-moving, cross-functional teams. Hands-on experience with LLM applications in production: structured outputs, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, and evaluation. Experience integrating with enterprise systems through APIs and data models, for example ERP, PLM, or requirements management tools. Experience with document processing, such as PDF parsing, OCR, or information extraction. Strong software practices: testing (pytest), CI, packaging, code review, and git. A product mindset. You talk to users, understand the problem before writing code, and ship in small, measurable steps. Clear, concise communication with both customer engineers and internal teams. Based in Cambridge (UK) or willing to relocate. Nice to have Background in mechanical engineering or physics, with exposure to DfM, DfA, or design-to-cost practices. Familiarity with requirements engineering and model-based systems engineering (MBSE, SysML). Experience working with CAD data or geometry processing. Experience with vision-language models, vector databases, or search ranking. What you get Ownership of a product capability that customers use in real engineering programs, with direct access to the engineers who use it. A competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale. A collaborative, multicultural team where your work is visible and recognized. Colleagues who share knowledge freely and support each other. A hybrid model and flexible hours. We focus on results and trust you to organize your time. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Fractional Product Lead - 3 month contract
text: We're customer obsessed. We put the customer at the heart of everything we do - and we're looking for people who feel the same way. About Bike Club Bike Club is the easiest way to keep kids on the right sized bike. Through our subscription model, we remove the hassle of buying, outgrowing and reselling children's bikes, so families always have the right bike, right when they need it. We are a purpose led, fast-growing business built on ease, care, progress and joy - with a relentless focus on customer growth, retention and building a more circular approach to children's cycling. Role Summary and Engagement Bike Club is looking for a fractional Product Lead to lead the member product, turn customer needs and commercial priorities into a clear direction and a prioritised roadmap, and deliver measurable improvements. The role combines senior Product leadership with practical discovery and delivery coordination in a lean team. The Product Lead will also establish an AI-enabled Product function, using AI to speed up customer insight, discovery, prototyping and experimentation. They will identify where AI and automation can improve the member experience or business efficiency, and turn the strongest opportunities into prioritised, measurable initiatives. This is a part-time fixed-term employment or freelance contract estimated at 3 days per week for a period of 3 months. Key Responsibilities Product direction and roadmap: own the direction and roadmap across the member lifecycle: joining, managing a subscription, ongoing membership, exchange and retention. Balance member value with operational efficiency, cost and business priorities. Discovery: lead discovery with members and colleagues across Marketing, Customer Service, Operations and markets. Use research, behavioural data and service insight to define problems before committing to solutions. Lifecycle and retention: work jointly with Marketing and the retention owner on lifecycle journeys, retention initiatives, experiments and shared measures. Product owns the supporting experience and requirements. Marketing owns campaign and channel execution. Requirements and backlog: turn agreed priorities into clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. Maintain one prioritised product backlog, including operational improvements and approved AI or automation initiatives. Investment cases: build proportionate cases for investment, setting out expected benefits, cost, dependencies and how outcomes will be measured. Recommend stopping or deferring work where value is insufficient. Delivery: agree delivery commitments with Engineering using realistic estimates and available capacity. Coordinate stakeholders, adoption and launches with the combined QA and Delivery role, keeping risks and changes visible. Marketing autonomy: support Marketing with appropriate content, landing-page and experimentation capabilities. Agree the boundary between the member product, CRM and support tools. AI in Product work: use AI routinely for research synthesis, analysis, requirements development, prototyping and experiment design, and validate findings against customer evidence. Prioritise valuable applications with Marketing, Customer Service, Operations and the Data and Automation function. Test assumptions and build proportionate business cases. Customer-service automation should support the wider member journey. Share responsibility with Marketing for using AI to support lifecycle insight, proposition testing and retention experiments, with agreed measures of customer and commercial impact. Leave things in a better state: because the engagement is part-time and time-limited, document the roadmap, backlog, ways of working and AI approach so the team can continue without the Product Lead, and hand over clearly at the end. Requirements Extensive Product Management experience including owning a digital product roadmap and delivering measurable customer and commercial improvements, preferably in a subscription, membership or related consumer business. Strong discovery skills, including customer interviews, journey mapping, data interpretation, problem definition and testing assumptions before investment. Commercial judgement: can compare value, effort, cost and risk, build practical investment cases and make clear prioritisation decisions. Ability to lead across functions, challenge senior stakeholders constructively and maintain focus when priorities compete. Experience working with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Customer Service and Operations through delivery, launch and continuous improvement. Demonstrable experience embedding AI into Product workflows, with examples of faster learning, better decisions or reduced effort. Able to distinguish valuable AI applications from features that add unnecessary complexity. Track record of working independently and effectively in a part-time, fractional or interim capacity, making visible progress in limited days a week. Able to start quickly, and leave behind clear documentation and repeatable ways of working. Measures Of Success Baselines, numerical targets, data sources and review dates are agreed with the executive sponsor and relevant business owners within the first 30 days. Delivery and outcomes are reviewed weekly. Member retention: improvement in the agreed retention or cancellation measure for targeted journeys, assessed jointly with Marketing and the retention owner. Member experience: improvement in self-service completion and reduction in avoidable support contact for prioritised journeys, without deterioration in customer experience. Conversion: improvement in agreed joining and exchange conversion measures, using experiments or comparable cohorts where practical. Speed of learning: reduced time from identifying a customer problem to testing a solution, with evidence that decisions remain grounded in customer insight. AI and automation: validated initiatives deliver agreed improvements in member experience, retention or operational efficiency, measured with the relevant business owner. Roadmap value: proportion of priority initiatives with a stated outcome, baseline and measurement plan before delivery, followed by a documented benefits review. Delivery confidence: performance against jointly agreed milestones, with changes in scope, priorities and dependencies recorded and communicated early. Our Values We look for people who live our values every day: Ease: we make things simple for our members and for each other. Care: we look after our customers, our colleagues and our bikes. Progress: we keep improving, learning and raising the bar. Joy: we help kids fall in love with cycling, and enjoy the work we do. Why Bike Club? You'll be joining a business with a clear purpose, a genuinely different proposition and significant opportunity to grow. This is a rare opportunity to build the operating system for our national refurbishment and distribution site from the ground up, shaping how Bike Club gets the right bike to every family, right when they need it.  Significant experience leading complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, interdependent deliverables and senior stakeholders. 
 A proven track record of translating strategic objectives into executable plans and delivering against challenging commitments. 
 Strong programme management expertise across integrated planning, governance, critical path management, risk, dependencies and change control. 
 The judgement to anticipate problems, navigate ambiguity and make effective decisions when priorities or delivery conditions change. 
 The confidence to challenge constructively, influence senior stakeholders and hold teams accountable across matrixed organisations. 
 Strong commercial awareness, including an understanding of budgets, forecasts and performance against agreed commitments. 
 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear decisions, recommendations and executive-level reporting. 
 A proactive, collaborative approach, combining attention to detail with a clear focus on overall programme objectives. 
 
 Experience in creative production, digital transformation, AI-enabled programmes or technology partnerships would be advantageous. 
 What success looks like 
 
 A clear, integrated programme plan that connects workstreams, milestones, dependencies and outcomes. 
 Predictable, well-controlled delivery, with risks anticipated, blockers resolved and commitments actively managed. 
 Clear accountability across workstreams and strong alignment between clients, partners and delivery teams. 
 Timely, informed decision-making supported by transparent reporting and a reliable view of programme performance.

 A programme that meets its objectives while adapting effectively as priorities and requirements evolve.

title: Director, Engineering, AI Search
text:
Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact. 
 About the Team 
 Algolia’s Engineering team builds the core infrastructure and product features that power real-time search and discovery for thousands of customers around the world. This includes backend services, frontend components, site reliability, and ML-powered capabilities. The team is distributed, collaborative, and committed to technical excellence and continuous learning. 
 As an Engineering Director , you will lead multiple teams or a critical product area, working closely with Engineering Managers, Product, and Design to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-impact solutions. You will play a key role in translating company strategy into execution, while building strong, autonomous teams and fostering engineering excellence. 
 Your Role Will Consist Of: 
 
 Leading a group of engineering teams (via Engineering Managers and Senior ICs) , ensuring alignment with product and company priorities 
 Demonstrates strong AI leadership within the engineering organization by fostering a culture of continuous improvement and proactively evaluating and applying emerging AI technologies to enhance productivity, efficiency, and organizational performance across the broader technology function. 
 Owning delivery, execution, and operational excellence for a defined product or platform area 
 Partnering closely with Product, Design, and cross-functional stakeholders to shape roadmaps and ensure successful delivery of customer value 
 Driving engineering best practices across system design, scalability, reliability, and performance 
 Being a member of Algolia’s senior technology leadership team, with significant contributions to engineering excellence and the high performance of the global technology organization, extending beyond the immediate area of responsibility. 
 Supporting and coaching Engineering Managers , helping them grow as leaders and build high-performing teams 
 Contributing to organizational planning , including headcount, team structure, and quarterly/annual planning cycles 
 Ensuring a strong culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement within your organization 
 Acting as a bridge between strategy and execution , translating high-level goals into clear team-level priorities 
 Serves as a trusted advisor to the CTO and SVP Engineering, providing strategic guidance on engineering leadership, organizational effectiveness, and cross-functional management initiatives across the technology organization. 
 
 You Might Be a Fit If You Have: 
 
 8–12+ years of engineering experience , including 3–5+ years managing multiple teams or managing through managers 
 Proven experience delivering complex, cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, high-growth environment 
 Strong technical background with experience in distributed systems, APIs, and scalable infrastructure 
 Demonstrated ability to lead through others , empowering managers and senior engineers 
 Excellent communication skills with the ability to align diverse stakeholders and drive clarity 
 Experience operating in distributed or global engineering environments 
 
 Nice to Have: 
 
 Experience in developer tools, infrastructure, or data platforms 
 Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) environments 
 Exposure to AI/ML-powered products or platforms

Base Salary Pay Range £160,000 — £200,000 GBP 
 FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY: 
 Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when.

Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.

We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and supported—regardless of race, age, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, color, veteran status, disability, or socioeconomic background.

 What You Bring:

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills 
 Detail-oriented with strong organizational abilities 
 Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities 
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
 Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or related field 
 Experience with JIRA and ServiceNow ticketing systems 
 Previous experience in training and documentation development 
 Familiarity with quote-to-cash (Q2C) or Deal Desk related processes 
 Experience in process improvement initiatives

Build rigorous evals and check the data behind every number Care about latency, cost and reliability as much as model quality Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment Example Projects Ship a new ranking model to production and prove the gain on our eval sets Push our models to the next level: better answers, lower latency, lower cost per query Build and maintain the evaluations framework that measures every change to our search engine Our Stack Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, Ray, Spark / Databricks, Vespa, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform Details The ideal candidate will play a central role in our engineering team, partnering closely with the founders. Join us and leverage your expertise to push the boundaries of AI! About Linkup Our Vision We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web . These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information. AI agents need web search . To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off. Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs . Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space. Web 2.0 is sunsetting . The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home. Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up . We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone. Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup. Our Mission Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve. Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs. Our Culture Our culture is built on the following values: Mission . We get things done, well. Ownership . We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion. Teamwork . Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset. Humility . We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences. We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture. title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctorant en vision et apprentissage : Détection automatique de défauts thermiques dans des prises de vues intérieures de façades pour l’aide au diagnostic de qualité des bâtiments
text: Présentation de l’Ecole et du laboratoire Créée en 1857, l’École Centrale de Lyon figure parmi le top 10 des écoles d'ingénieurs en France. Elle forme plus de 3 000 élèves de 50 nationalités différentes sur ses campus d'Écully et de Saint-Étienne (ENISE, école interne) : ingénieurs généralistes, ingénieurs de spécialités, masters et doctorants. Avec le Groupe des Écoles Centrale, elle dispose de 3 implantations à l’international. La formation dispensée bénéficie de l’excellence de la recherche des 6 laboratoires labellisés CNRS présents sur ses campus, des 2 laboratoires à l’international, des 6 réseaux de recherche internationaux et des 10 laboratoires communs avec des entreprises. Sa recherche d’excellence et son enseignement de très haut niveau lui permettent de nouer des accords de doubles diplômes avec des universités prestigieuses et des partenariats de pointe avec de nombreuses entreprises. Autour des thématiques de sobriété, d’énergie, d’environnement et de décarbonation, Centrale Lyon entend répondre aux problématiques des acteurs socio-économiques sur les grandes transitions. Ce projet de recherche sera mené au sein du Laboratoire LIRIS (UMR 5205), et en particulier de l’équipe Imagine dont les travaux visent notamment à développer de nouveaux modèles d’apprentissage et de vision pour l’analyse et la compréhension de données visuelles telles que les images et vidéos. Présentation de la thématique : Cette mission s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet Therm_I_Bat associant le LIRIS à l’entreprise CMDL Manaslut Ing. et dont l’objectif est de proposer de nouvelles méthodes d’IA et de Vision par Ordinateurs pour la détection automatique de défauts thermiques dans des prises de vues intérieures de façades pour l’aide au diagnostic de qualité des bâtiments. Description de la mission La performance énergétique réelle des bâtiments neufs ou rénovés reste souvent en deçà des performances visées en conception, créant un « energy gap » qui freine la décarbonation du secteur. CMDL a développé une solution robotisée capable de réaliser des campagnes de mesures exhaustives (thermographie infrarouge et images RGB) sur des plateaux de bureaux, logements ou usines d’environ 5 000 m² en une nuit. Cependant, aujourd’hui, le traitement est opéré par un expert sur un nombre restreint de fichiers. La multiplication du nombre de fichiers ne permet pas d’imaginer la mobilisation de l’expert, et seul un traitement automatisé sur la base d’un apprentissage du type Intelligence Artificielle est envisageable. Le projet THERM_I_BAT vise à concevoir et valider une preuve de concept de diagnostic intelligent des façades de bâtiments, à partir de prises de vues intérieures réalisées par une plateforme robotisée. Scientifiquement, le projet s’inscrit dans les travaux de recherche et R&D sur l’analyse d’images multimodales et l’apprentissage frugal, en développant de nouveaux modèles d’IA capables de fonctionner avec des jeux de données limités mais fortement contextualisés. Industriellement, il prépare une solution de diagnostic automatisé de la qualité d’enveloppe, compatible avec les outils de la filière (BIM, jumeau numérique) et économiquement acceptable pour un déploiement massif à la réception des bâtiments. Le planning envisagé est le suivant : Phase 1 – Acquisition et préparation des données (M1–M12) • Définition des protocoles de mesure avec CMDL (typologies de bâtiments, scénarios de défauts). • Réalisation de campagnes de mesures robotisées (IR + RGB) sur plusieurs sites pilotes. • Constitution d’un jeu de données annoté (défauts, zones saines, contexte BIM). Phase 2 – Contextualisation spatiale et fusion multimodale (M3–M5) • Alignement spatial des images IR et RGB, prise en compte de la géométrie des façades. • Développement de méthodes de fusion multimodale pour produire des représentations conjointes robustes. Phase 3 – Segmentation sémantique et filtrage des perturbations (M6–M9) • Développement de modèles de segmentation sémantique pour distinguer les zones pertinentes (parois, menuiseries, éléments techniques) des perturbations (mobilier, objets, reflets). • Intégration de connaissances expertes CMDL pour guider les classes et les règles de filtrage. Phase 4 – Détection d’anomalies et classification des défauts (M10–M16) • Mise en place de modèles de détection d’anomalies thermiques et de classification des défauts (ponts thermiques, défauts d’étanchéité à l’air, artefacts liés aux matériaux). • Apprentissage frugal à partir de jeux de données limités, complétés éventuellement par des données simulées. Phase 5 – Génération du diagnostic et validation en environnement pertinent (M16–M18) • Génération automatique de diagnostics structurés (liste de défauts, typologie, sévérité) et localisation dans le plan/BIM. • Campagnes de validation sur de nouveaux bâtiments, comparaison avec l’analyse d’experts humains (temps, précision, taux de faux positifs/faux négatifs). • Consolidation de la preuve de concept (TRL 5) et préparation des suites de valorisation. Profil recherché / Compétences attendues Diplômes : Doctorat en Informatique Connaissances requises : Vision par Ordinateurs, Apprentissage automatique, Apprentissage profond Compétences opérationnelles : Bonne maîtrise du langage Python et de librairies d’apprentissage profond telles que PyTorch, de l’anglais, et bonnes qualités rédactionnelles et de communication orale Compétences comportementales : Motivation, rigueur, autonomie, proactivité. title: AI platform engineer
text: Wil jij werken op het snijvlak van cloud, platform engineering en AI? title: Senior MLOps Engineer, Buyer
text:
Brief info about Vinted 
 Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission: Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life. Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces. Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members. Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. Information about the position 
 The Buyer domain's Data Science teams build and iterate on our most critical ML systems—like ranking, retrieval, and recommendations—that serve millions of users. As our ambition and the complexity of these models grow, we are scaling our MLOps capabilities to match: 
 We are hiring an MLOps Engineer to solve this. This is a high-impact "bridge" role, not to build new platforms, but to be the expert user of our existing platforms (GCP/Vertex AI, Vespa, Triton). Your mission is to take our Data Science team's work, rectify the current ad-hoc solutions, and build the robust, automated, and high-quality "path-to-production" our advanced models require. 
 Also by joining Vinted, you’ll become part of an active community of engineers who are keen on sharing knowledge, organizing learning workshops and so much more! 
 In this position, you’ll 
 
 Productionise ML models: be responsible for migrating all existing model training code from experimental or proof-of-concept stages to robust and automated pipelines. 
 Build continuous training (CT) pipelines: design, build, and maintain automated workflows for data preparation, model training, and batch scoring. 
 Automate model serving & integration: package and deploy traditional ML models (e.g., in ONNX format) to our existing serving infrastructure, primarily Vespa and/or Triton. 
 Close the deployment loop: automate model deployments where they are still manual. For example, building a GitHub Action that deploys a new model to Vespa, triggered by a webhook from a successful Vertex AI training pipeline. 
 Build the missing quality gates: build the automated quality and evaluation gates that our pipelines lack today. This includes: 
 Establish and uphold ML Model Lifecycle Standards: Take ownership of and continuously improve the standards, quality, and governance of the complete ML model lifecycle. 
 
 About you 
 
 We are looking for an "ML-literate" Software Engineer, not a Data Scientist. You are a builder and an automator with a strong service mindset. 
 Must-have technical skills: deep expertise in GCP/Vertex AI (or equivalents like SageMaker), Kubernetes, and Docker. 
 Automation expertise: proven experience building robust CI/CD and automation pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.). 
 ML-Literate: you understand ML workflows and concepts (training, evaluation, inference) well enough to debug pipelines and build meaningful quality gates. 
 Soft skills: a strong "service mindset," excellent communication, and the ability to act as a bridge between the highly technical worlds of Data Science and Infrastructure. You are pragmatic and driven to get high-quality work into production. 
 Bonus Points: familiarity with ML serving platforms like Vespa search engine or NVIDIA Triton and model formats like ONNX. 
 Willingness to learn and master new technologies and concepts. 
 We value pragmatism, big-picture thinking, curiosity, and problem-solving skills. 
 
 Work perks 
 
 The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme 
 25 days of paid annual leave 
 Newest MacBook models 
 Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family 
 Frequent team-building events 
 Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture 
 A daily lunch allowance 
 Company bike leasing scheme 
 Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform 
 Work from Home allowance 
 Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan 
 A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted 
 An NS mobility card 
 A dog-friendly office 
 
 Working at Vinted 
 
 Workation policy 
 
 
 Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time. 
 
 
 Individual learning budget 
 
 
 Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development. 
 
 
 Hybrid work 
 
 
 Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person. 
 
 
 Equal opportunity 
 
 
 We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match! 
 The annual gross salary range for this position is: €89.000 — €121.400 EUR Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Full Stack Developer (Onboarding & Enablement)
text: We turn every customer interaction into an opportunity. We connect conversations, customer data and payments with AI Agents so that companies can deliver personal customer journeys at scale: both online and in person. “The entire customer journey. One platform” What we value Every CM.com colleague, connects to our 4 shared values : Drive and Lead You take initiative, make decisions and recognize opportunities. Making mistakes is part of moving forward. Grow and Learn The growth of our colleagues and our customers is our priority. You like to experiment, learn continuously and actively share knowledge and insights with others. Together and Care We work together and we believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. You value the social side of work, you show genuine interest and care about one another’s well-being. Speed and Change By welcoming AI Agents into our organisation, we fundamentally change how work is done. You are comfortable with change and you love working in a high paced environment. The Role As a Full Stack Developer in the Onboarding & Enablement team, you'll own the front door of CM.com connectivity: the self service experience where customers sign up and start messaging in minutes, without a sales call or a single email. It is one of the most important topics at CM.com today, and your team is the conductor behind it. In today's tech market, speed wins. Customers choose the provider they can start with right now, and they value ease over a long list of requirements. Think of how quickly you can take out a phone subscription: that is the experience we want to offer. Our customers are people, but increasingly also AI agents, and neither wants to wait for a callback. Behind that one simple interface sits a complex platform. Every channel works differently. For example: WhatsApp runs via Meta, RCS via Google and Orange, and more channels and suppliers are joining. Customers should never notice any of that. The complexity is ours, not theirs. You will Build the self service onboarding experience that takes customers from sign up to their first message in minutes Turn every customer request into the right configuration across our own systems and external suppliers, fully automated Make it easy to plug in new channels and supplier partnerships, so the platform grows without adding complexity for the customer Drive automation across the full customer journey, for people and AI agents alike Own your work from idea to production, including how it runs on our infrastructure Use AI tools actively to improve your own work: experiment, automate, and share what works with your team Medior to senior full stack developer with hands on experience in both front end and back end Strong in Angular on the front end, and in C# and .NET on the back end Solid knowledge of relational databases, such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL Fluent in English and Dutch Nice to have: experience with DevOps or system engineering, as the team also manages its own infrastructure Genuinely curious about AI: you experiment with tools like ChatGPT or Copilot and you're open to working differently as they improve Believe you’d be a great fit for this role, even if you don’t tick every box? Reach out to our Recruitment team! We’d be happy to connect and see if we can make it work together. What we offer As a CM.com club member, you’ll have the following benefits: Onboarding : Join our unique 3-days Global Onboarding program in our Headquarters in Breda, a deep dive into the culture of CM.com. Healthy food: Daily healthy lunches and snacks to keep you energized. Effortless commute: The Shuttle mobility card, commuting allowance and Lease-a-bike options get you where you need to be. We have CM company cars that you can use for client visits as well. Invest in your future : A solid pension plan. Time off: Recharge with 25 vacation days, plus the option to purchase 10 additional days. Own your success: Become a shareholder with our Employee Share Purchase Program. Your Development : We support your growth and development through initiatives like the CM Academy, Udemy courses, exclusive meetups with thought leaders, the Young Professional Program, and our own CM Business Adventure (CMBA), ensuring you’re always learning and evolving Vitality : Our Vitality Team organizes a year-round vitality program to support a healthy body and mind for all colleagues. Think of stress prevention workshops, ergonomist visit, weekly bootcamps, yoga sessions and our CM sports day. Together at CM.com : Weekly drinks, board game nights, karaoke throwdowns, yearly ski trip, and more! We have something for everyone. Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and drive us forward. We welcome everyone, regardless of age, background, or beliefs. Before you apply We work on-site, move fast, and expect you to bring your own thinking. Priorities shift, AI is actively changing how we work and we embrace that reality. If that sounds like a great environment to you, we'd love to hear from you. Note: For this position, we can only consider candidates who already hold a permanent work and residence permit for the Netherlands. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Medior Software Engineer
text: Ben jij een Software Engineer die graag zelfstandig bouwt aan slimme, schaalbare software? Wil je technische uitdagingen oplossen, meedenken over nieuwe functionaliteiten en jezelf blijven ontwikkelen binnen een ervaren productteam? Dan is deze functie bij BAS World iets voor jou! Bij BAS World ontwikkelen we digitale producten waarmee klanten wereldwijd trucks, trailers, machines en onderdelen kunnen kopen en verkopen. Onze software ondersteunt internationale handelsprocessen en wordt dagelijks gebruikt door klanten en collega's over de hele wereld. Als Medior Software Engineer werk je binnen een van onze productteams aan betrouwbare en schaalbare software. Je pakt zelfstandig technische vraagstukken op, denkt mee over de beste oplossingen en bent betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkelproces: van het begrijpen van het probleem tot het bouwen, testen en onderhouden van de oplossing. Je werkt nauw samen met andere Engineers, Product Owners en collega's vanuit de business. Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om technische keuzes te maken, nieuwe ideeën aan te dragen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Wat ga je doen? Als Medior Software Engineer werk je aan digitale producten die direct bijdragen aan de groei van BAS World. Je schrijft niet alleen code, maar denkt ook actief mee over hoe we onze software en processen kunnen verbeteren. Je werkt binnen een van onze vijf productpijlers: Operations, Parts & Tyres, Buyer, Seller of Platform Engineering. Samen met jouw team ontwikkel je oplossingen die waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten en collega's. Jouw werkzaamheden: Je ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en onderhoudt schaalbare en betrouwbare software; Je pakt zelfstandig nieuwe functionaliteiten en technische vraagstukken op, van analyse tot implementatie en beheer; Je werkt samen met Product Owners, Engineers en collega's vanuit de business om klantbehoeften te vertalen naar technische oplossingen; Je denkt mee tijdens de discoveryfase, onderzoekt verschillende oplossingsrichtingen en test ideeën waar nodig met prototypes; Je schrijft leesbare, testbare en onderhoudbare code en draagt bij aan de kwaliteit, beveiliging en betrouwbaarheid van onze software; Je voert code reviews uit, werkt samen via pair programming en deelt actief kennis met collega's; Je onderzoekt en verhelpt incidenten en denkt mee over structurele oplossingen; Je signaleert technische verbeterkansen en experimenteert met nieuwe technologieën en moderne engineeringtools. Je krijgt de vrijheid om zelfstandig aan oplossingen te werken, maar staat er nooit alleen voor. Je leert van ervaren collega's, deelt jouw eigen kennis en werkt samen aan producten die dagelijks wereldwijd worden gebruikt. Wat maakt deze functie zo interessant? Bij BAS World werk je niet alleen aan technische oplossingen, maar denk je ook mee over de ontwikkeling van onze digitale producten. Je krijgt de ruimte om kritische vragen te stellen, ideeën te testen en invloed uit te oefenen op technische keuzes. Je werkt in een productgedreven organisatie waar we continu zoeken naar manieren om onze software slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken. Of je nu nieuwe functionaliteiten ontwikkelt, bestaande systemen verbetert of experimenteert met AI en cloud-native technologie: je krijgt volop mogelijkheden om jezelf technisch verder te ontwikkelen en steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Wij bieden jou Een aantrekkelijk salaris dat past bij jouw kennis en ervaring; 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen; Een goede pensioenregeling; Veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid binnen een ervaren productteam; De mogelijkheid om te werken aan digitale producten die wereldwijd worden gebruikt; Volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen via interne en externe opleidingen; De vrijheid om te experimenteren met AI, cloud-native technologie en moderne engineeringtools; Directe samenwerking met ervaren Engineers, Product Owners en andere technische specialisten; De keuze tussen een MacBook of Windows-laptop; Een informele, internationale werkomgeving met korte lijnen en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Jouw specificaties We zoeken een Software Engineer die zelfstandig kan werken, graag technische uitdagingen aangaat en verder kijkt dan alleen het schrijven van code. Wat breng je mee? Je hebt ervaring als Software Engineer en kunt zelfstandig nieuwe functionaliteiten en technische oplossingen ontwikkelen; Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk, van het ontwerp tot een betrouwbare werking in productie; Je schrijft leesbare, testbare en onderhoudbare code; Je denkt mee over technische keuzes en weet jouw ideeën en oplossingen duidelijk uit te leggen; Je werkt graag samen met collega's, staat open voor feedback en deelt actief jouw kennis; Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologieën en denkt graag mee over verbeteringen; Je werkt minimaal vier dagen per week vanuit ons kantoor in Veghel, zodat je nauw kunt samenwerken met jouw team. Daarnaast heb je ervaring met meerdere van de volgende technologieën en werkwijzen: PHP, Laravel en/of andere moderne frontend- en backendtechnologieën; Cloud-native softwareontwikkeling, bij voorkeur binnen AWS; API's, data-uitwisseling en gedistribueerde systemen; CI/CD, geautomatiseerd testen en databases; Softwarearchitectuur, observability, security en schaalbaarheid. Je hoeft niet overal expert in te zijn. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je een goede technische basis hebt, zelfstandig kunt werken en gemotiveerd bent om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Interesse? Wil jij bouwen aan digitale producten die wereldwijd worden gebruikt en jezelf verder ontwikkelen als Software Engineer? Solliciteer dan direct en ontdek jouw mogelijkheden bij BAS World! Wij zijn BAS! BAS is een internationaal familiebedrijf dat sinds 1962 actief is in de automotive-sector. Met meer dan 1.000 collega's zijn we wereldwijd actief in de handel en het onderhoud van vrachtwagens, trekkers, trailers, bouwmachines, bedrijfswagens en landbouwmachines. Via ons platform basworld.com brengen we kopers en verkopers van over de hele wereld samen. Onze ambitie is om uit te groeien tot de toonaangevende wereldwijde marktplaats voor gebruikte commerciële voertuigen en machines. Binnen BAS World werken onze Product- en Tech-teams dagelijks aan de ontwikkeling en verbetering van onze digitale producten. We werken productgedreven en volgens agile principes, waarbij we nieuwe ideeën onderzoeken, testen en ontwikkelen om zo snel mogelijk waarde toe te voegen voor onze gebruikers. Bij BAS houden we van aanpakken, samenwerken en kansen benutten. Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap vormen de basis van onze organisatie.
